items.title: Pay coworking invoice for December flex desk
items.quote: Please settle this invoice within 14 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: Invoice date is Saturday, 21 Nov 2026. This is a civil-law (private contract) deadline triggered by an event, so §187(1) BGB applies: the day of the event (21 Nov) is not counted, and the period starts the next day, 22 Nov 2026. Counting 14 days from 22 Nov: 22-30 Nov = 9 days, 1-5 Dec = 5 days, total 14 days, so the period ends on 5 Dec 2026 (a Saturday). Under §193 BGB, if the last day of a period for a declaration or payment falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period extends to the next business day. 5 Dec 2026 is a Saturday and 6 Dec 2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday, 7 Dec 2026, which is a normal business day in NW (no intervening public holiday).
